transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Okafor, your Signal Officer. Let's get our daily communications planning huddle started. We have channels C1 through C4 available for tomorrow's routine coordination, and the signal shop can configure channels and power settings before 1800 today. The standard plan uses C1 for command, C2 for logistics, C3 for clinic support, and C4 for airfield services. I need operations, logistics, maintenance, and airfield representatives to report your current requirements so we can finalize and publish the binding configuration. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a change for the command net. The battalion coordination directive confirmed this morning requires the command net to use C2 from 0600 to 1000 tomorrow. I received the directive after the morning briefing, and the communications slide has not yet been updated. This means C2 will be occupied by command during that window, so we'll need to sort out an alternate channel for logistics during those hours.
